title: nf-core/starlight pipeline parameters
description: A pipeline to process long read spatial transcriptomics data

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/starlight/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

chopper_options.title: Chopper read QC options
chopper_options.description: Optional read QC with Chopper before Restrander. Set chopper_enabled to true to filter and trim reads by quality.

chopper_enabled.description: Enable Chopper quality trimming and filtering before Restrander. When false, input reads are passed directly to Restrander.

chopper_trim_approach.description: Chopper trimming strategy applied to each read.

chopper_cutoff.description: Per-base Phred cutoff for end trimming (requires trim-by-quality, best-read-segment, or split-by-low-quality).

chopper_min_quality.description: Minimum mean read Phred quality; reads below this are discarded (-q).

chopper_maxlength.description: Maximum read length after trimming (--maxlength). Leave unset for no limit.

chopper_contaminants.description: Optional reference FASTA for contaminant removal (--contam).

barcode_localization_options.title: Barcode localization options
barcode_localization_options.description: Parameters controlling read orientation with Restrander and Spatial Barcode extraction.

n_reads.description: Subsample input reads to this many reads per sample using seqtk sample (random seed 100). Leave unset to skip subsampling.

restrander_config.description: Path to the Restrander JSON configuration file used to orient raw ONT reads.
restrander_config.help_text: Restrander is a mandatory pipeline step. The default config targets PCB109 chemistry (poly-A/T classification followed by TSO/RTP primer detection). Override this path to use a different chemistry configuration.

rt_adapter.description: Constant 45 nt cDNA-RT adapter anchor sequence used as the landmark in parasail alignment.

barcode_length.description: Spatial Barcode length in base pairs.

barcode_polya_length.description: Length of the poly-A tail included in the parasail probe sequence.

barcode_window.description: Number of bases from the 3' end of each read used as the alignment query.

barcode_gap_open.description: Gap-open penalty for the parasail SW alignment.

barcode_gap_extend.description: Gap-extend penalty for the parasail SW alignment.

barcode_max_anchor_ed.description: Maximum edit distance between the aligned RT-adapter hit and the reference anchor sequence.

barcode_min_qv.description: Minimum base quality (Phred) required across all Spatial Barcode bases.

min_barcode_len.description: Minimum accepted barcode length. Barcodes shorter than this are dropped. Barcodes between min_barcode_len and barcode_length are right-padded with G's (quality Phred 0). Default: null (strict — must equal barcode_length).

adapter_anchor.description: 20 bp constant adapter anchor immediately 5' of the structured UMI, used for 5' alignment.

umi_window.description: Number of bases from the 5' end of each read used as the UMI alignment query.

max_adapter_ed.description: Maximum edit distance for 5' adapter anchor check. Reads exceeding this still get CR/CY but UR/UY are set to empty.

min_cdna_len.description: Minimum R2 (cDNA) length in bp after splitting. Shorter read pairs are discarded.

barcode_whitelist.description: Path to the Spatial Barcode whitelist CSV file (first column = barcode sequence).

strategy.description: QUIK barcode calling strategy. GPU strategies (e.g. 5_mer_gpu_v5) require a GPU; host_v1/host_v2 run on CPU only.

distance_measure.description: QUIK distance metric used for barcode matching.

rejection_threshold.description: QUIK rejection threshold. Defaults to barcode_length * 0.25 when not set.

enable_columba_rescue.description: Extract rejected reads into separate FASTQ files for downstream Columba barcode rescue.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome_fasta.description: Path to reference genome FASTA file. Required unless --genome_mmi is provided.

genome_mmi.description: Path to a prebuilt minimap2 .mmi index. When provided, MINIMAP2_INDEX is skipped.

genome_gtf.description: Path to gene annotation GTF file. Required for StringTie transcriptome assembly when stringtie_enabled is true.

junc_bed.description: Path to splice junction BED file for minimap2 --junc-bed. Generate once with: paftools.js gff2bed annotation.gtf > ref_genes.bed

save_reference.description: Publish the generated minimap2 .mmi index to outdir/genome/.

stringtie_enabled.description: Assemble a sample transcriptome with StringTie from primary genome alignments, then align cDNA reads to it with minimap2. Only used when gene_quant_mode is epi2me.

gene_quant_mode.description: Downstream gene quantification path: epi2me (StringTie + assign_features + create_matrix), isoquant (UMI-tools dedup + IsoQuant on genome BAM), or oarfish (R2 FASTQ → transcriptome align → UMI dedup + Oarfish, scnanoseq-style).

retain_introns.description: IsoQuant: retain intronic reads by setting --gene_quantification all and --transcript_quantification all. When false (default), uses unique_inconsistent (gene) and unique_only (transcript), matching published ONT scRNA pipelines.

isoquant_args.description: Additional IsoQuant CLI flags appended after pipeline defaults (--complete_genedb, sensitive_ont model construction, default_ont splice correction, etc.).

isoquant_read_group.description: IsoQuant --read_group value for per-barcode quantification (e.g. tag:CB).

isoquant_use_primary.description: Filter to primary alignments (-F 0x904) before UMI-tools dedup in isoquant mode.

oarfish_args.description: Oarfish CLI flags for single-cell transcriptome quantification.

oarfish_save_transcript_secondary_alignm.description: When true, transcriptome FASTQ alignment uses minimap2 -N 100 (retain secondaries for Oarfish EM). Set false for stricter primary-only alignment.

umitools_dedup_method.description: UMI-tools dedup --method for isoquant and oarfish modes.

umitools_dedup_extra_args.description: Additional UMI-tools dedup CLI flags appended after defaults in isoquant/oarfish modes.

stringtie_mode.description: StringTie mode: assembly (default, -L) or estimate (-L -e, reference transcripts only).

stringtie_opts.description: Additional StringTie CLI options appended after -L.

strandedness.description: Library strandedness passed to StringTie (--fr / --rf) and IsoQuant (--stranded forward|reverse|none).

gene_assign_min_mapq.description: Minimum genomic alignment MAPQ for gene assignment (assign_features).

gene_assign_min_tr_coverage.description: Minimum transcript coverage for multimapping read resolution (assign_features).

gene_assign_min_read_coverage.description: Minimum read coverage for multimapping read resolution (assign_features).

gene_assign_chunksize.description: BAM chunk size for assign_features processing.

matrix_chrom.description: Chromosome label written into barcode tag records for create_matrix.

matrix_chunk_size.description: Approximate row chunk size when reading barcode tags in create_matrix.

matrix_ref_interval.description: Genomic window size (bp) for unassigned reads in create_matrix.

matrix_umi_length.description: Expected UMI length; discard reads with corrected UMIs of other lengths. Default: no filtering.

matrix_skip_umi_clustering.description: Skip UMI clustering in create_matrix and use pre-corrected UB tags.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified. If you don't have a BWA index available this will be generated for you automatically. Combine with `--save_reference` to save BWA index for future runs.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
